headline: Yugal Kishor Garg resigns as Chief Financial Officer of CMR Green Technologies
hook: CFO exit at CMR Green Technologies
summary: CMR Green Technologies Limited has announced that Mr. Yugal Kishor Garg is stepping down from his position as Chief Financial Officer. His resignation is scheduled to take effect from October 23, 2026. The company has formally notified the stock exchange regarding this leadership change. Retail investors in unlisted or associated securities of the firm should track the appointment of a successor.
whats_next: Announcement of a new CFO appointment before October 2026
why_it_matters: Leadership changes at the CFO level warrant tracking financial oversight stability.

headline: CMR Green Technologies files AGM voting results
hook: CMR Green Technologies concludes annual shareholder voting
summary: CMR Green Technologies has submitted the scrutinizer's report following its Annual General Meeting held on September 29, 2026. The company also disclosed the official voting results from the meeting to the exchange. This filing confirms the completion of standard corporate governance procedures for the fiscal year.
